newsitem.title: USA: International Standards sets share buyback.
newsitem.headline: International Standards sets share buyback.

text.p: International Standards Group Limited said on Thursday its board of directors approved a $12 million share buyback program.
The company said in a statement it would buy back stock before and after its previously-announced stock split, but it was not allowed to buy back more than $12 million in stock.
International Standards also said its board named Donald Booth as company president and Ron Berry as treasurer, effective November 1.
Booth had been president of the company's TWT subsidiary and Berry had been the controller of that subsidiary.

International Standards Group has filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to change its name to Total World Telecommunications Inc, or TWT. This had been the name of its subsidiary, it said.
Joseph Lents would continue to serve as chairman and chief executive officer, the company said.
International Standard said on September 13 it filed a statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up to a one-for-15 reverse common stock split.
